method: Retrieved GitHub UTF-8 text, computed SHA-256 of LF representation and the same bytes with each LF replaced by CRLF; CRLF hash exactly equals the comparison receipt's frozen reference hash. This reconciles two byte encodings of identical numerical content.
interpretation: Frozen reference contents were committed before the comparison. Windows checkout yielded CRLF for a JSON file without a prior LF attribute. Comparison used that equivalent content, not a new or modified reference law.
limits: Implementation-independent analytic reference and mutation check; not independent author verification. A Pearson chi-square nonrejection is not a formal proof of correctness.
